events.verdict: Antetokounmpo (MIL) establishes himself in a screening position and the contact as Haliburton (IND) moves around the pick is marginal.
Antetokounmpo (MIL) and Siakam (IND) briefly engage and disengage on the perimeter.
Trent Jr. (MIL) reaches in and initiates contact to Siakam's (IND) arm, which affects his control of the ball.
Lopez (MIL) grasps and immediately releases Turner's (IND) jersey.
Nembhard (IND) extends his forearm as he sets the screen on Lopez (MIL), who is able to move through the marginal contact.
Haliburton (IND) maintains his pivot foot prior to jumping into his shooting motion.
Antetonkounmpo (MIL) establishes a screening position in Haliburton's (IND) path prior to releasing the pass and absorbs the incoming contact during the pick.
Siakam (IND) grazes Antetokounmpo's (MIL) arm in the post.
Lopez (MIL) contests Nembhard's (IND) jump shot and the contact after the release, and follow-through, is marginal.
Antetokounmpo (MIL) firms up in a screening position in Nembhard's (IND) path and does not deliver contact.
Prince (MIL) moves laterally into Nembhard (IND) and initiates illegal contact that affects his driving shot attempt.
McConnell (IND) commits a take foul on Lillard (MIL).
Haliburton (IND) avoids stepping out of bounds while in possession of the ball.

Replay review of the foul called on Antetokounmpo (MIL) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Antetokounmpo closes out on Haliburton (IND) and initiates illegal contact to his lower body during the jump shot attempt.
Nesmith (IND) legally contests Antetokounmpo's (MIL) jump shot attempt.
